decisions.title: Volume floor is compared against cumulative fallback volume, so dead markets are never filtered
decisions.reason: The changed predicate uses `volume`, which the preceding unchanged line resolves to `m.volume` whenever `m.volume_24h == 0`. For a market with no 24h trading but lifetime volume 5000 (above the stated default floor 10), `has_volume` is True, so `new_count` resets to 0 every scan and the market can never reach the stale threshold. The patch does not contradict this; the only unshown assumption is the floor value, which the candidate identifies as 10, but the logical flaw is present in the changed code.
